summary: Tested Leave Balance Dashboard + real-time bank sync. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass covering GET /leave-balances-by-type/{vacation|sick|holiday}, create/update/delete leave-record balance mutations, sick-cannot-go-negative (P-021), holiday can go negative and restore. Frontend: /battalion-chief/leave-balances loads with 3 tabs, 5 summary cards (Personnel/Total Hours/Negative/Low Balance/At Cap), table with all required columns (Name, Payroll #, Shift, Type, Balance, Cap, Status), search filter works, tab switching works and shows correct balance for test user 200001 (vacation 16.0 hrs / sick 108.0 hrs). Vacation Management 'Show Balances' toggle opens a Vacation Balances panel with 'Real-time' badge, correctly filtered to A-shift on-duty personnel.

issues: The 'used' number shown in the balance card (e.g. '224.0 used / 240 cap') is derived as cap - current_balance in LeaveManagementPage.js:226. Since cap is the rollover cap (not an annual allocation), this 'used' figure is misleading for vacation/sick which accrue monthly. The dedicated Leave Balance Dashboard correctly shows only current balance + cap and does not have this issue.

action_items: Optional: reconsider computing 'used' as (cap - current_balance) in the LeaveManagementPage balance panel; for accrual-based banks this is not a true 'used' amount. Consider hiding 'used' or replacing with 'current' progress bar of balance/cap.
critical_code_review_comments: overtime_routes.py create_leave_record: when sick would go negative, the code silently clamps to 0 (loses hours). Consider returning a 400 or an explicit warning to the caller so the UI can surface it. Currently API returns 200 with no indication that not all requested hours could be deducted.

overtime_routes.py update_leave_record: does not re-check leave_type change. If a leave record's type is edited from vacation->sick, the balance delta is applied to the NEW leave_type only, but the original vacation deduction is never restored. This is an edge case but a data-integrity risk.
LeaveManagementPage.js fetchLeaveBalances (line 226): 'used = cap - current_balance' is inaccurate for monthly-accrual banks (see design_issues).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing personnel 200001 (Test User). All test leave records created were deleted at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_leave_balance_dashboard.py can be rerun for regression. Feature is functional. Only enhancement suggestions remain, no blocking bugs.
